title: Grayscale PDF for Printing — Convert Color to B&W
description: Save printer ink by instantly converting colored PDF documents to black and white or grayscale directly in your browser.

sections.title: Save Expensive Printer Ink
sections.content: Colored ink is expensive. Convert your PDFs to grayscale before printing to save money and resources.

sections.title: How to Make PDF Black & White
sections.content: Just drop your file in the box. Our local tool will instantly strip all colors and give you a perfectly printable grayscale PDF.

sections.title: Best B&W PDF Converter
sections.content: Convert colored text, images, and backgrounds to shades of gray without losing readability.

sections.title: Private Grayscale Conversion
sections.content: Your documents are converted in your own device's memory. We never see your files.

sections.title: Lightning Fast Processing
sections.content: Because we don't upload your file to a cloud server, the grayscale conversion happens almost instantly.
